copies.speaker: registry-clerk
copies.text: Mm-hm. Photo, signature… and three photocopies of your admission letter?

choices.text: Here. Three copies, as the letter said.
Uncle Bright said you're the kindest person in Admin.

prepared.speaker: registry-clerk
prepared.text: Wonderful. Somebody actually reads. You'll go far.

two.speaker: registry-clerk
two.text: The letter is old; the rule is new. …Fine. I'll copy one for you. Just this once.

flattery.speaker: registry-clerk
flattery.text: Bright says that to everybody. …It's working, though.

card.speaker: registry-clerk
card.text: Here's your student ID. Don't lose it — the porter has a whole drawer of lost cards. You're in Hastech Hostels, Block A. Room A-214.

pause.speaker: registry-clerk
pause.text: A-214… Hm. Nothing. It's nothing. Go on — your roommate will be waiting.
